scope: Freeze existing real-Ribasim/RibaMod product semantics needed by the SWAP5 management coupling. No further general Ribasim characterization is authorized by this work unit.

application_envelope: fixed lower coupling plane head/flux interface
one accepted interface transfer with opposite-sign counterpart

qualified_product_semantics.meaning: allocation.dt owns UserDemand management cadence in the tested actual RibaMod route; saveat does not define a competing allocation cadence.

qualified_product_semantics.head: 64813e01f3817794f457f467be2f0724797a72c5
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Post-allocation groundwater transfer can be physically realized while the current fixed allocation remains unchanged.

qualified_product_semantics.head: 80f242625ccf3f5714bb521707f1136a1e4f779d
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Realized groundwater transfer changes accepted Ribasim state and becomes management-visible at the next allocation boundary, without retroactive reallocation.

qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Accepted surface-water stage can drive MF6 River exchange with reciprocal physical feedback to Ribasim.

qualified_product_semantics.head: 8e25378f25b7ea409e39db1b39c36702f9032c56
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Current-boundary negative infiltration forcing can be physically active but is not necessarily visible to the fixed allocation solved at that same boundary.

qualified_product_semantics.head: e8d08860289629d5491bf2a6780727cea9d9c4cd
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Physical realization and allocation forecast have distinct low-storage semantics.

qualified_product_semantics.head: 84f05671bafcd0cd8fe22d115980889bc5491a00
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Accepted Basin memory and newly computed current forcing are distinct next-boundary allocation inputs.

qualified_product_semantics.head: b860a5b13a09ef40bd33056f65617b8bb3491237
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Positive drainage forecast and negative infiltration forecast are direction-sensitive and not algebraically interchangeable in the tested release.

qualified_product_semantics.head: ad833c879493764f5f087efcbff5edb8203f674a
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: Current positive groundwater drainage can be admitted as forecast supply in addition to accepted storage memory.

qualified_product_semantics.head: fd66d678f242941cbcffec251931418fa5c80ecd
qualified_product_semantics.meaning: A noncommensurate allocation boundary crossed inside one BMI update_until can be skipped; correct coupling must therefore schedule explicit management boundaries.

falsified_or_superseded_assumptions: sub-saveat BMI UserDemand application is automatically effective
current-boundary active River/infiltration must alter the allocation solved at the same boundary
allocated water is identical to physically supplied water
positive and negative current groundwater/surface-water forcing are symmetric allocation inputs
crossing an allocation boundary inside update_until guarantees an allocation solve
actual_coupling_requirements: SWAP physical demand, Ribasim request, allocation and physical supply are distinct objects.
Only accepted physical supply may become SWAP irrigation input and accepted water mass.
Rejected SWAP/coupler trials may not mutate accepted SWAP or Ribasim state.
Management solve occurs at an explicit coupler-owned Ribasim allocation boundary.
Accepted state memory and current forecast forcing remain separate.
The coupler must split advances at relevant noncommensurate management boundaries.
Groundwater exchange uses the already closed fixed-interface authority and must not reopen drainage or storage ownership.
